LocalizedUpdateText.title: LocalizedUpdateText
LocalizedUpdateText.description: Localized headline and release summary for a single supported language.

title.description: Localized headline of the update or announcement.

summary.description: Localized detailed release notes or announcement body.

UpdateTranslations.title: UpdateTranslations
UpdateTranslations.description: Optional dictionary of localized release notes keyed by supported language code.

AppUpdate.title: AppUpdate
AppUpdate.description: Official release notes, feature updates, and announcements for Complete Notebook.

title.description: Primary fallback headline of the update or announcement.

version.description: Application version tag such as 1.0.1+1 or v1.0.1+2.

summary.description: Primary fallback release notes or announcement body.

defaultLang.description: Primary language code used as default fallback for this release.

translations.description: Optional per-language map of localized titles and release notes.

playStoreUrl.description: Optional direct Google Play link for the release.

pinned.description: Whether this announcement is pinned at the top of the feed.

published.description: Whether this announcement is publicly visible to global visitors.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the developer who published the update.

authorName.description: Public display name of the publisher (e.g. RyhStar Innovation).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the update was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the update was last modified.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Trusted administrator membership record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

grantedByUid.description: UID of the developer admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was recorded.

/app_updates/{updateId}.description: Publicly readable (when published == true) official multilingual app changelogs and announcements managed exclusively by verified RyhStar Innovation admin.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted admin registry keyed by UID with zero PII fields.
